Location: 		Alexandria, NSW, 2015
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Job Title: 		Baker
Salary range: 	$79,500 - $85,000
Job Closure date:30 days

About This Role:
Our client is a beloved artisan bakery renowned for its commitment to traditional baking techniques and high-quality, handcrafted products. With a passion for creating delicious, wholesome breads, pastries, and desserts, they take pride in using time-honoured methods and premium ingredients to deliver exceptional baked goods to their community.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Baker to join their dedicated team. In this role, you will be responsible for crafting a variety of artisanal breads, pastries, and desserts while maintaining the highest standards of quality, consistency, and food safety. The ideal candidate will have a strong work ethic, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for the art of baking.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Production & Baking:
• Prepare, mix, knead, and shape dough using traditional methods to create artisanal bread, rolls, and pastries.
• Monitor fermentation and proofing processes to ensure optimal texture and flavour development.
• Carefully load, bake, and unload products, adjusting oven temperatures and baking times for perfect results.

Quality Control & Preparation:
• Inspect raw ingredients for freshness and accuracy, measuring and weighing components to exact specifications.
• Taste-test and evaluate product consistency, adjusting techniques as needed to maintain high standards.

Equipment & Workspace Maintenance:
• Conduct thorough checks of baking equipment and work areas before production to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.
• Clean, grease, and maintain baking trays, tins, and machinery to uphold hygiene and operational efficiency.
• Operate dough mixers, rollers, and cutting machines safely, ensuring proper handling and maintenance.

Skills & Requirements:
• Proven 1- 2 years’ full-time experience as a Baker in an artisanal or commercial bakery setting.
• Qualification Certificate III in Baking or above
• Strong knowledge of baking techniques, fermentation, and dough handling.
• Ability to work early mornings, weekends, and holidays as required.
• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality products.
• Understanding of food safety standards and hygiene best practices.
• Physical stamina to stand for long periods and handle heavy baking equipment.

If you are passionate about traditional baking and thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to be part of a team that takes pride in crafting exceptional baked goods with care and expertise.

Please note: We are acting as the recruitment agent on behalf of our client, and the employer’s identity will be disclosed upon application.

result.description: Toro Australia  Toro Australia is seeking an experienced Field Service Technician to join our service team.  The successful candidate will be responsible for servicing, testing, diagnosing and repairing a range of turf maintenance and small-engine equipment at Toro’s facility and designated customer locations. This includes lawn mowers, garden tractors, line trimmers, golf course equipment and other petrol- and diesel-powered small-engine and turf-maintenance equipment.  The position will ensure that equipment is maintained and repaired in accordance with Toro’s policies, procedures, product standards and customer requirements.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Inspecting, testing, diagnosing, repairing, maintaining and servicing lawn mowers, garden tractors, turf-maintenance equipment and other petrol- and diesel-powered small-engine equipment.   Testing, diagnosing and repairing small petrol and diesel engines and associated hydrostatic transmissions, hydraulic systems, electrical systems and battery-powered systems fitted to small-engine and turf-maintenance equipment.   Locating worn, damaged or improperly adjusted engine parts and mechanical components through visual inspection and the use of appropriate test and diagnostic equipment.   Removing, dismantling, repairing and replacing small engines, associated transmissions, electrical components and other mechanical components using appropriate tools and safe work procedures.   Disassembling engines and associated components and inspecting parts for wear or damage using micrometers, calipers, thickness gauges and other measuring devices.   Adjusting engine valves, checking engine compression and diagnosing engine-related faults and failures.   Locating electrical faults and short circuits and completing necessary repairs in accordance with product service manuals and electrical wiring procedures.   Repairing or replacing worn and defective parts and reassembling engines and mechanical components in accordance with manufacturer specifications.   Testing and adjusting engines and repaired mechanical or electrical components to ensure proper performance.   Performing scheduled preventative and corrective maintenance, including oil changes, lubrication, engine tune-ups and other servicing requirements.   Discussing equipment malfunctions with customers and equipment operators to assist with fault diagnosis and determine the repairs required.   Responding to equipment breakdowns and undertaking emergency repairs on malfunctioning turf-maintenance and small-engine equipment.    Qualification & experience  You are a skilled and safety-focused mechanic with practical experience servicing and repairing small-engine and turf maintenance equipment. You are comfortable working independently at customer locations, diagnosing complex faults and completing repairs in accordance with manufacturer specifications. You will also have a professional approach to customer service and be able to clearly communicate the nature, progress and outcome of repair work, as well as:   A relevant trade qualification, or at least three years of relevant experience in small-engine maintenance and repair, which may substitute for the formal qualification.   Relevant experience maintaining, diagnosing and repairing lawn mowers, garden tractors, turf-maintenance equipment and other small-engine equipment.   Experience using mechanical and electronic test and diagnostic equipment.    A valid Australian driver licence.   Ability to travel as required, including interstate or overseas travel where necessary.   A commitment to complying with Toro’s workplace health, safety and environmental policies and safe work practices.    About Company    Toro Australia supplies a broad range of turf and landscape maintenance equipment, mowers, irrigation systems and construction equipment to customers across the golf, sports field, landscaping, government, commercial and residential sectors. The company is recognised for its commitment to product innovation, quality, strong customer relationships and ongoing service and support. Where there's life, there's Mercy. 

Where there's care, there's You.

Through the battles and the breakthroughs, we're there. Where will you be?

For over a century, our incredible teams have provided care for people at every stage of life. Across our aged care homes, hospitals and research facilities, and across numerous cities and towns, we're on a journey to keep growing our impact for the next hundred years.

As a for-purpose organisation with over 10,000 dedicated, compassionate people, we continue to offer more services and deeper care than ever before. With Mercy, you'll have the chance to make an impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

At Mercy Health, it's all about taking what we have and making it better. 

To do that, we need you. 

Join us at Mercy Health, and help our teams deliver even greater outcomes. 

About the opportunity

At Mercy Health, you'll become part of a proud history built on over 100 years of expertise, skill and care. As [insert role title], you'll use your [insert key skills-areas of expertise needed for this role - e.g. high-level organisational skills] to help achieve even more for all who need us.

What you'll bring
 

It takes a special kind of person to work in healthcare or community services. If you are genuinely interested in helping others, then you'll find you can build something here and find your place in a team of 10,000 hearts.

To thrive in this role, you will have:

Experience developing and maintaining reports, workflows, and scripts using tools such as Power BI, Excel, The Lookout Way, or similar.

Ability to collect, cleanse, and validate data from multiple sources.

Strong analytical skills to identify trends and insights.

Ability to work with stakeholders to deliver clear, actionable outputs.

Experience automating reports and processes (e.g. Workato, Power BI).

Strong attention to detail and timely issue resolution.

Experience in application support, technical support, or system maintenance.

Ability to design and implement solutions in automation or scripting environments.

You will also be required to provide evidence of, or in the process of obtaining:

A current Police Record Check.

Ready to help us shape the future of healthcare?

Join us and make a meaningful difference in people's lives - and your career.

We extend this acknowledgment to the many Traditional Lands that we operate across Australia and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

The team at Mercy Health is as wonderfully diverse as the patients, residents, clients and communities we support.
